definitions.explanation: The act of copying someone's actions, speech, or behavior.
Often used in negative expressions to criticize certain behavior.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}は{親|おや}の{真似|まね}をする。
そんな{馬鹿|ばか}な{真似|まね}はやめなさい。
{猿真似|さるまね}では{上達|じょうたつ}しない。
examples.english: You won't improve by just mindlessly copying.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{真似|まね}をする (to imitate)
・〜の{真似|まね} (imitation of ~)
・{馬鹿|ばか}な{真似|まね} (foolish behavior)
・{危|あぶ}ない{真似|まね} (dangerous behavior)
・{猿真似|さるまね} (blind imitation, monkey-see-monkey-do)

USAGE NOTE:
{真似|まね} can be neutral (children learning by imitation) or negative (copying without understanding, or engaging in unacceptable behavior).

RELATED VERB:
・{真似|まね}る (to imitate, to mimic)
